item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
The whole theme of the tale is quite wholesome, but I do feel like it misses out on possible character development for the witch/main character through some negative aspects of their relationship. It feels like the story starts out in a good mood, and ends with a good mood, which robs it of an interesting dynamic. Outside of the "she will not break me" that comes a bit outta nowhere, there aren't any conflicts or other kinds of problems in their relationship, which could be used to solidify the ending, so plot ends up feeling rather descriptive. There's also the subplot of Sseth and his animals, but (as a person who haven't read much of this canon) I didn't feel like enough information about this was given to feel engaged.

It's a little nice tale that gives a glimpse into the hub, but I do feel like it could've been much better. Novoted.
